channel.title: Microsoft SOC Brief
channel.description: Due within 7 days, new since the last brief, Microsoft changes in Graph and roles

item.title: [Due today] Stricter Conditional Access evaluation can break Teams Android device sign-in from late September
item.description: Teams · Due today · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due today] App Governance permissions change for three Entra roles as Defender XDR Unified RBAC takes over
item.description: Defender XDR · Due today · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due today] The legacy Microsoft Graph security alerts API (/security/alerts) stops returning data after 15 October, and its replacement does not return every alert the old one did
item.description: Graph · Due today · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due in 1 day] Loading Power Query data to Python in Excel Web: Retirement
item.description: M365 Apps · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-16

item.title: [Due in 4 days] EntraIdSignInEvents replaces AADSignInEventsBeta on 19 October 2026
item.description: Defender XDR · Due in 4 days · deadline 2026-10-19

item.title: [Due today] Three Entra roles change what they can do in App Governance
item.description: Entra · Due today · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Production PCA 2011 expiry and next-generation code signing
item.description: Windows · Due in 4 days · deadline 2026-10-19

item.title: [Due today] Autopatch gains separate control over quality updates, .NET Framework and quick machine recovery
item.description: Windows · Due today · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due in 5 days] SharePoint starts reporting site metadata size and warning on it
item.description: SharePoint · Due in 5 days · deadline 2026-10-20

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Entra sign-in pages start enforcing a Content Security Policy in mid-October; injected scripts stop running on login.microsoftonline.com
item.description: Entra · Due in 4 days · deadline 2026-10-19

item.title: [Due today] SharePoint one-time passcode retirement slips: Phase 2 now starts mid-October and runs to the end of November
item.description: SharePoint · Due today · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due today] Defender for Cloud Apps switches the SaaS accounts integration with Identity inventory on automatically from 15 October
item.description: Defender XDR · Due today · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [New] Copilot Studio retires GPT-4.1, GPT-5 Chat/Auto/Reasoning and GPT 5.6 Sol/Luna on 12 November and migrates agents automatically
item.description: Copilot Studio · New · deadline 2026-11-12

item.title: [New] Windows Server 2022 left mainstream support on 13 October; security updates continue to 14 October 2031
item.description: Windows Server · New · deadline 2026-10-13

item.title: [New] Windows Server 2016 gets its last security update in January 2027 (90-day reminder); Essentials features end the same day
item.description: Windows Server · New · deadline 2027-01-12

item.title: [New] Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2021 gets its last security update in January 2027 (90-day reminder)
item.description: Windows · New · deadline 2027-01-12

item.title: [New] The October 2026 Scan Cab (wsusscn2.cab) is now available, a day late
item.description: Windows · New

item.title: [New] Teams meeting options will offer only the automatic recording and transcription choices the organizer's policy allows, and add 'Record only'
item.description: Teams · New

item.title: [Due in 1 day] Microsoft 365 Copilot subscriptions are renamed '(add-on)' from 16 October; scripts that match SKU names should switch to SKU IDs
item.description: Copilot · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-16

item.title: [New] Teams will flag phishing and social engineering in external first-contact chats with AI-based detection (roadmap, November 2026)
item.description: Teams · New

item.title: [New] Teams will detect malicious QR codes in messages in near real time (roadmap, December 2026, government clouds)
item.description: Teams · New

item.title: [New] Purview DLP policies for Copilot, Copilot Chat and Cowork can be scoped to administrative units (roadmap, November 2026)
item.description: Purview · New

item.title: [New] Purview server-side auto-labeling will cover legacy .doc, .xls and .ppt files in SharePoint and OneDrive (roadmap, November 2026)
item.description: Purview · New

item.title: [New] Reminder: the Microsoft-managed 'Require risk remediation for high-risk users' policy switches itself On the week of 28 October
item.description: Entra · New · deadline 2026-10-28

item.title: [New] Sensitivity labels for Entra cloud security groups reach GA from mid-November; a label once applied cannot be changed or removed yet
item.description: Purview · New

item.title: [New] Exchange Online DLP gains a 'Count of labeled documents is greater than' condition (preview November, GA December)
item.description: Purview · New

item.title: [New] October Patch Tuesday fixes an exploited Windows Shell security feature bypass (CVE-2026-96951, CVSS 8.8)
item.description: Windows · New

item.title: [New] October 2026 security updates: 174 Critical CVEs, among them AD DS and Exchange Server remote code execution and an AD FS spoofing flaw
item.description: Windows · New

item.title: [New] Defender for Identity's October release adds 21 alerts: AD CS ESC1/ESC8/ESC11 abuse, diamond tickets, DPAPI master key theft, Temporary Access Pass sign-in and seven Okta detections
item.description: MDI · New

item.title: [New] Advanced hunting: AgentsInfo loses its Preview label and Microsoft deletes the AIAgentsInfo table page from the schema reference
item.description: Defender XDR · New

item.title: [New] Security Defaults can be managed rule by rule (private preview), including a new 'Block device code flow' protection, and no longer has to be off to use Conditional Access
item.description: Entra · New

item.title: [New] Application Developer is now documented with 15 actions on the app registrations its holder owns, including adding credentials
item.description: Entra · New
